title: Actual quotient cohomology sections of the algebraic Hom complex
statement: Let X be a scheme, A a commutative ring in the coefficient universe, J an ideal, U an object of its coefficient-sized pro-etale site, and P,Q integer cochain complexes of A-modules. Use the actual signed total Hom complex C=moduleHomComplex(P,Q) [def-sc-module-total-hom-complex]. Define a Type-valued inverse sequence by taking, at level n, zeroth cohomology of C/J^(n+1)C, then sections of its constant A-module sheaf on the slice over U at its final object. Its maps are the cohomology maps induced by the actual quotient transitions. This is the quotient short-complex tower [def-sfb-adic-short-complex-quotient-tower] of C.sc(0), followed by constant-module sections. No finiteness or exactness is part of this definition.
